verdict.rationale: Ramp ships in-product AI agents (Ramp Intelligence), so letting users connect external MCP servers to them is a plausible capability for this kind of product. The evidence, however, documents Ramp only in the MCP server role: Ramp MCP, Developer MCP and Ramp Data MCP all expose Ramp to outside assistants. Nothing shows Ramp's own agents consuming tools from MCP servers the user plugs in, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.
